mapper.select: SELECT * FROM system_scheduled_task ORDER BY id ASC

SELECT * FROM system_scheduled_task WHERE enabled = 1 AND next_run_at IS NOT NULL AND next_run_at <= #{now} AND (lease_until IS NULL OR lease_until <= #{now}) ORDER BY next_run_at ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE system_scheduled_task SET description = #{description}, cycle_type = #{cycleType}, interval_value = #{intervalValue}, interval_hours_part = #{intervalHoursPart}, interval_minutes_part = #{intervalMinutesPart}, time_of_day = #{timeOfDay}, day_of_week = #{dayOfWeek}, day_of_month = #{dayOfMonth}, month_of_year = #{monthOfYear}, interval_minutes = LEAST(1440, GREATEST(5, CASE WHEN #{cycleType} = 'INTERVAL_SECONDS' THEN GREATEST(5, CEILING(#{intervalValue} / 60.0)) WHEN #{cycleType} = 'INTERVAL_MINUTES' THEN #{intervalValue} WHEN #{cycleType} = 'INTERVAL_HOURS' THEN #{intervalValue} * 60 WHEN #{cycleType} = 'INTERVAL_DAYS' THEN #{intervalValue} * 1440 ELSE 60 END)), enabled = #{enabled}, next_run_at = #{nextRunAt}, lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE task_code = #{taskCode}

UPDATE system_scheduled_task SET lease_owner = #{owner}, lease_until = #{leaseUntil}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND enabled = 1 AND next_run_at IS NOT NULL AND next_run_at <= #{now} AND (lease_until IS NULL OR lease_until <= #{now})
UPDATE system_scheduled_task SET next_run_at = #{nextRunAt}, lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND lease_owner = #{owner}
